inspectedText: The publicly viewable ISO preview states the halving and similarity principles, gives the side-to-diagonal-of-square ratio, defines the A-series basis, and lists A3/A4/A5 integer-millimetre sizes. It also recognizes alternate North American office sizes and size tolerances. Only the available preview was inspected; full tolerance continuation and Annex A were unavailable.
inspectionMethod: Source body opened in session web tool; ISO public preview parsed by page. This is an original inspection summary, not a saved HTTP/PDF body or fabricated full-text acquisition.

limitations: Partial preview, not purchased full standard.
